messages:
maria: dropped a tiny prototype + staging preview. Quick question for UX: while the model is streaming, should the primary action be 'Pause generation' (reversible) or 'Stop generation' (final)? And where to surface the token counter: inline under the streaming message or top-right header? figma: https://figma.com/proto/stream-ux :eyes: devin: leaning 'Pause generation' as primary (less scary). Put 'Stop' in overflow as a hard cancel. Inline control near the message keeps context. Also add aria-pressed / aria-atomic states. sam: inline token counter please. Header is too detached. Collapse the exact number by default (show estimate) and reveal exact on hover or focus for privacy. Tooltip: "Estimated tokens used (prompt + output)". elaine: a11y checklist: use `aria-live="polite"` on the stream container; set `aria-busy="true"` while streaming. Announce state changes ("Generation paused", "Generation resumed"). Ensure keyboard focus lands on the Resume button after pause. kayla: microcopy: primary label = "Pause generation (Esc)". Secondary stop = "Stop and discard". Show a subtle inline badge when paused: "Paused — resume to continue". For regenerate, overlay the message with "Regenerating" + spinner rather than creating a new node. maria: good notes. Proposal: primary = Pause (inline), Stop in overflow, token counter inline and collapsed. We'll run a 5-person internal test to see confusion with wording. devin: example aria snippet for prototype: ```html
``` And update to `aria-busy="false"` when complete. Also expose status text via an offscreen element for screen readers. sam: tooltip copy: "Estimated tokens used (prompt + output)". Control tooltip: "Pause generation (keyboard: Esc)". Make token counter focusable (tabindex=0) so keyboard users can reveal details. elaine: keyboard mappings: Esc toggles pause/resume when focus in chat; when paused, move focus to the message actions. `/` to focus prompt composer. Ensure high-contrast focus ring on small token control. ui-bot: accessibility quick-pass: aria-live yes, aria-busy yes, state announcements pending, keyboard focus rules pending. staging-bot: Preview deployed at https://playground.staging.redwood/preview/stream-ui-183 (expires in 72h) maria: action items: @devin implement aria-live/aria-busy + offscreen announcements in prototype; @sam put inline collapsed counter + tooltip; @elaine add keyboard focus rules and keybindings to the a11y doc; @kayla write the paused badge copy. I'll update figma with two variants (Pause-primary + Stop-primary) and share results after the quick test. :thumbsup:
